title: Meet loan covenants and reporting
summary: Track the loan's financial tests, reserves and reporting dates and deliver what the lender needs.
outlineSteps: List every covenant, test date and reporting due date in the loan documents
Add the guarantor's own reporting and financial tests
Compute coverage on the lender's NOI definition each test period
Project coverage from the rent roll to see a breach coming
Track rate exposure, caps and swaps on floating debt
Fund and draw reserves as the loan requires
Assemble and deliver the reporting package on time
Get lender consent before lease changes that need it
Tell the lender early if a test may fail
File what was sent and the lender's acknowledgments
